recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下，密集的中型芽細胞具細緻染色質、圓形至不規則核與稀少細胞質，並可見數個有絲分裂，零星夾雜深染的紅血球前驅細胞與含鐵血黃素，符合 B-ALL 骨髓浸潤。
features: Densely packed sheets of medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to irregular nuclei, some with indentations, with finely dispersed chromatin
Inconspicuous to small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm
Several mitotic figures scattered through the infiltrate
Few residual erythroid precursors and scattered brown hemosiderin deposits; megakaryocytes not evident
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows diffuse sheets of medium-sized blasts with scant cytoplasm, round to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, with frequent mitotic figures. Residual hematopoiesis is limited to scattered erythroid precursors, megakaryocytes are not evident, and hemosiderin deposits are present focally. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia, supported by the CD34/TdT/CD79a/CD10-positive immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps on H&E; myeloid markers (MPO, CD117, CD33) without B-lineage markers indicate AML.
Indistinguishable on H&E; cytoplasmic CD3 positivity and absence of CD79a/PAX5 define T lineage.
Burkitt has more basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, a starry-sky pattern and a TdT-/CD34- mature B phenotype.
